batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b A Kumble

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c CL White b KP Appanna

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c PD Collingwood b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b A Mishra

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b A Mishra

balls.text: length ball just outside off, Vettori eyes midwicket, can't get bat on ball, races through for the bye, Uthappa misses the stumps, so Delhi finish on 184, reckon that's enough?
carved down to wide long-on by Vettori for a couple
Vinay keeps it full, only a single this time

poor cricket here, Vettori walks a long way outside off, looks to swing the ball down towards fine leg, off the pads and Uthappa can't collect it, Pietersen does at fine leg, should have been a run-out at the non-striker's end with Vettori haring for the third but the bowler can't collect the ball cleanly
full ball just outside off, muscled down the ground by Vettori, Kallis dives at long-on but can't cut off the boundary
full and slow, 99kmh, well outside off, Vettori lets it through to the keeper, expects it to be a wide but it was just inside the line
a gigantic six from Collingwood, again length ball, the batsman packs some serious power behind that swing over midwicket, huge height as well as distance on that hit
shortish ball on legstump, Vettori backs away and slaps it towards midwicket for a single
in the blockhole this time, driven towards mid-on
length ball, don't bowl there, Collingwood blasts it over long-off for yet another six
mishit from Collingwood, looks to swing it over the legside, gets a thick outside edge towards third man, the ball spins sharply after bouncing to wrongfoot the fielder there, Appanna it was
short and well outside off, hacked away towards cover by Vettori
full and just outside off, powerfully driven towards sweeper cover
a slow bouncer, middle stump line, Vettori moves across and looks to swing it towards fine leg, doesn't connect
length ball well outside off, driven along the ground to mid-off
Collingwood dispenses with fancy stuff and goes back to the basics, down the track and mowed over midwicket for six more
Collingwood looks to reverse-paddle the ball, it's a slower legcutter from Vinay, strikes Collingwood on the pads
Vinay starts with a bouncer into the batsman, Vettori keeps that out with an ungainly swipe, it goes off the bat and into the helmet's grill
back to dot balls, Collingwood can only push the final delivery of the over back to Kumble
that's more of what Delhi need, Collingwood gets to the pitch of the ball and effortlessly launches him over long-on to bring up his half-century
Kumble gets in three dot ball in a row, Colling looks to sweeps that one but the ball rolls towards the off side
again down the ground, can only defend towards the bowler
Collingwood comes down the pitch and pushes the ball towards mid-off
full and swept towards short fine leg
Vettori comes down the track, can't get bat on ball, rolls off the pads towards the off side
Vettori completely foxed by that slower ball, miscues the ball towards mid-off, ball is in the air for a long time but the fielder is at long-off, so Vettori is safe
pushed towards cover for a single
short ball, Collingwood  charges down the track, and muscles the ball past long-on for four
length ball just outside off, driven towards mid-on
length ball slanting into the pads, Vettori flicks it behind square leg for a four, no power at all behind that shot
driven towards mid-off by Collingwood
not as full as the previous ball, same width, dabbed towards third man
full and wide outside off, squeezed out towards backward point

is that a stumping? Jadhav look to glance the ball down towards fine leg, it rolls off his pad and then the gloves towards the keeper, Uthappa collects and whips off the bails with Jadhav out of his ground
only the singles coming for Delhi, this time to sweeper cover
moves towards leg and chops the ball towards sweeper cover
pitched up, on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-on this time
another single, leading edge towards mid-off this time
another single to third man, Bangalore won't mind that
slanting down the leg side, Mithun will have to re-bowl that one
full toss outside the off stump, Collingwood punches it to deep extra cover, has to settle for a single
deftly played there, opens the face late to guide a length ball outside off towards third man
slashed towards deep point by Collingwood
end of a good over from Appanna, fired into the pads, nurdled behind square leg
length ball just outside off, gently played towards midwicket
chops it towards backward point
looks to cut but misses
pushed towards long-off for a single
well, that should be the end of the White experiment, another short ball, Collingwood is making the area behind midwicket a hard-hat area with his sixes
not as short as the previous one, Collingwood opens himself up and muscles it wide of long-on for four
terrible delivery from White, half-tracker, sits up for Collingwood, who clobbers it over midwicket
blocked towards the off side
whoah, that was the widest ball of the tournament, slipped out of White's hand and barely lands on the pitch, way outside off
swung away towards midwicket when Appanna misfields
not much turn this time, a massive inside-edge onto the pads
back of length, batsman backs away but mistimes his cut towards cover
nudged towards backward point this time, a sharp single is taken
fuller from Appanna, tucked towards midwicket

White continues the trend of Australians taking stunning catches, Karthik smashed that shortish ball off the backfoot, White throws himself full-length to his left to pluck a low-catch, that was a blinder
again plenty of turn, pitching short and on off, spinning past Karthik's bat
plenty of turn for Appanna, short and turns away, hit towards cover point
beautiful hit from Karthik, a pitched up delivery, fullish, Karthik moves to leg and caresses it down the ground, long-on and long-off converge but the ball beats them
some smart running gets Karthik a couple off his first delivery, he jabbed that one towards sweeper cover

Kumble does the trick for Bangalore, as he has all tournament, Warner looks to smoke one over long-on again, but doesn't get as much on it as he liked, that was a googly from Kumble, Warner's hit is taken by Kohli a couple of yards in from the rope
short and wide, Collingwood taps it towards backward point
Warner makes room and cuts it towards cover this time
Kumble sends down a short one, Warner slaps it towards deep midwicket
pushed towards extra cover by Collingwood this time, and that's the time-out
single to midwicket this time
that is a massive hit, one of the biggest of the tournament, gets the front leg out of the way and bludgeons it over wide long-on
length ball, Warner says than-you-very-much, takes a couple of paces and dismisses the ball beyond long-on
width again, just wide of cover point to allow time for the single
short and wide, would have been called a wide of Collingwood left that alone, he can only chop it to cover point
angling into offstump, Collingwood plays it towards sweeper cover
short of length again, Collingwood looks to swat it to midwicket again but the ball sneaks under his bat
not so good from Collingwood this time, looks to cut that one but doesn't connect
lovely hit from Collingwood, waltzes down the track and smacks it over midwicket for six, it was an offcutter from Kallis, batsman spotted it early
back of a length on offstump, defended towards cover by Collingwood, 135.5kmh
short and a touch wide, Warner blasts it down towards long-off
end of a super over from Pietersen, Collingwood drives the last ball towards sweeper cover
defended off the front foot to the off side
on middle and leg, guided to short fine leg
gets a single to cover this time, played with soft hands
played watchfully towards extra over
starts with a delivery that turns a long way, Warner is beaten as he looks to drive through the off
Collingwood shuffles across the stumps and glances the ball fine, Appanna dives at the fine-leg boundary to stop that one

Appanna's direct hit gets Bangalore a big wicket here, Warner was cramped for room by that delivery angling in, he taps it towards cover, where Appanna fields and throws down the stumps at the striker's end, Gambhir wasn't really at top speed till he saw Appanna field
slower ball again, worked towards cover this time
Kallis bangs it in short, Warner blazes that one towards mid-on where Kumble can't latch on to a tough chance, that a boundary, serious power behind that shot
he starts with a slower delivery, 112kmh, pitched up and outside off, driven towards mid-off
not too expensive for RCB, full and just outside off, Warner smashes it towards mid-off, when Kevin Pietersen does the fielding
keeps it short, Warner was looking to wallop that one, miscues it towards square leg, Mithun has overstepped, free-hit coming up
short again, this time on middle and leg, Warner moves towards leg and pushes the ball towards mid-off
short and wide, 135.8kmh, third man is in the circle, Warner upper cuts it over the fielder for another boundary
short of length and on the pads, Gambhir clips it behind square leg for a single
what a response from Mithun, a short 135.9kmh ball that jags back a long way, follows Sehwag who has no room to play a stroke, he looks to jab it, but it rolls of his glove and onto the stumps,
he's greeted with a stunning hit from Sehwag, carved over cover point for a six, the ball just clears the ropes
a back of the hand slower ball this time, 101 kmh, Sehwag punches it to mid-off
slower ball, 105kmh, back of a length, middle stump line, Sehwag takes a couple of paces down the track but can only push it back to the bowler
Sehwag's in top gear here, gets the front leg out of the way and swings the ball over mid-on for a one-bounce four
Warner blasts it along the ground to long-off, vinay has a fielder in the deep there
fuller from Vinay, on middle and leg, flat-batted towards mid-on
slapped through covers by Warner this time, short and wide, slow delivery, Warner waits and cracks the ball past a diving fielder, that's 18 runs in the last four balls
Sehwag! down the track and hits it beautifully straight over the bowler's head for six, he's not concerned about those dot balls
and again, more power behind the shot this time, and it's lofted for four more over extra cover
gets the boundary this time, moves towards leg a touch and caresses the ball through extra cover
third dot ball in a row, Sehwag can't get it past Kumble again
keeps it full, Sehwag pats it back to Kumble
shouts of 'Catch it' as Sehwag thumps the ball towards mid-off, Appanna collects nicely off the half volley
steered towards backward point for a single this time to keep the strike
no one keeps Sehwag quiet for long, not that wide from Vinay but Sehwag makes room and carves it behind backward point for four, it's a fast outfield at the Kotla
third dot ball in a row, this time Sehwag defends towards mid-on
just  back of a length and on the pads, Sehwag taps it towards midwicket
a legcutter from Vinay, Sehwag looks to drive through the off, misses
not such a good start from him, a half-volley on the pads, flicked past short fine for four by Sehwag
tight first over from Kumble, Sehwag reaches across and drives the final ball towards sweeper cover for a single
crisply driven off the front foot towards extra cover
punched towards mid-on this time, straight at the fielder
just outside off, Sehwag looks to crack it through covers but misses, Uthappa can't collect cleanly
topspinner first up to Sehwag, who misses it and is hit on the pads, that was sliding down leg though
short ball to start, Warner swings it to square leg, Kumble lucky that that ball was only taken for a single

Delhi complete a convincing victory, wide outside off, batsman looks to swing it to midwicket again, misses, keeper collects, and Delhi move to 12 points and take sole possession of second spot in the table
drilled to long-on for a single
the hat-trick is saved, swung towards square leg
the googly does the trick, Mishra gets another wicket, batsman had no clue about that one and the stumps are re-arranaged
how many catches will Warner take before this tournament ends, he picks up one more, Draivd tried to clear long-on but the ball lobs to Warner
short and well outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover
again Gambhir at extra cover does the fielding after Draivd makes room and pushes the ball towards him
moves outside leg and drills the ball to extra cover
flat-batted down to long-off for a single
makes room and smashes it through extra cover for four
punched off the back foot towards the bowler
Vettori strikes, can't blame Vinay for swinging at everything, he comes down the track and looks to heave to midwicket, the ball slips under his bat and crashes into middle and off stumps
slower ball, 108.9 kmh, loops towards Dravid, who slugs the ball towards wide long-on
full and on the pads, dug out to backward square leg
Kohli's stay is over, looks to swing the ball over midwicket, he misses and the ball spears into middle and leg stumps
a yorker on legstump, inside-edged towards square leg by Dravid
a powerful hit form Dravid, it was a full ball, not much footwork from Dravid as he clubs it to long-off
short ball, flatbatted towards long-on for a single
an ugly across-the-line hit from Kohli, miscued towards extra cover, Gambhir spills a fairly straightforward catch
Dravid looks to clear long-on, gets an inside-edge, the ball rolls just wide of the keeper, was a run-out chance if the keeper hit the stumps
drilled to long-off for a single
well outside off, Dravid chops it towards backward point, Sehwag dives to his right to stop that one
typical Dravid shot, makes room and carves it past a diving extra cover
tries to pull it, but mistimes it towards square leg
low full toss on legstump, squeezed out towards square leg
length ball outside off, Kallis looks to clear long-off but gets too much height on that shot, Collingwood has a simple catch
full toss on middle, Kohli can't do much with it, driven down to long-on
Kallis stays back and crunches it to long-off for a single
down to fine leg for a single this time
low full toss outside leg, Kohli dispatches it behind square leg
a wild heave from Kohli, gets the top-edge which swirls towards third man but lands safely
pushed towards extra cover again, much less power in this stroke
slammed powerfully towards extra cover, Gambhir jumps but can't hang on to it, pops out of his hand
on the pads, turned towards square leg

that's the end of Taylor, is that the end of Bangalore's challenge in the match as well, Taylor goes for the sweep again, but is hit below the knee-roll in front of off and middle, the umpire sends Taylor on his way
Kallis keeps adding to his collection of half-centuries, gets a single down to long-off
crazy hitting form Taylor, fullish ball just outside off, Taylor decides to go straight this time, flat-batted swat sends the ball soaring over Warner
swung towards deep square leg by Kallis
nearly the wicket Delhi want, a top-edge as Taylor looks to swipe again but it lands short of Maharoof
short and quick outside off, misses the ball
Welcome to the IPL Taylor, that is another massive hit, this ball was closer to the stumps, Taylor batters that one over square leg
full and wide outside off, Taylor is going to hit to midwicket wherever you bowl, that was a powerful hit
full ball just outside off, Kallis gets on one knee and lofts it wide of long-off, fielder dives in vain as he attempts to stop that one
Warner is in the action again, Taylor pushes the ball to long-on, he wants the second but is sent back, and has to scramble to make his ground
way outside off, Taylor targets midwicket with a big swing, misses, appeal for a stumping, but he's in
on the pads, flicked towards midwicket for a single
chopped towards point, straight towards the fielder
length ball is driven towards wide long-on
thick outside edge flies towards third man for a single
Warner you beauty, makes amends for dropping one earlier in the over, he charges forward from long-on and dives to complete a low catch, in-form Uthappa has to go
a low full toss is dug out towards point
single to long-off this time
turned to midwicket for a single

whoah, Collingwood almost completes a blinder, Kallis lofts it straight, Warner and Collingwood converge, Warner drops a straightforward catch, Collingwood was behind him and reacted quickly, nearly latching onto the ball which spilled out of Warner's hand
slapped in the gap between deep point and deep cover
no doubts about that one , slmmed over wide long-on for a six
comes on quicker than he expects, but Uthappa manages to cut that one towards backward point
slapped towards sweeper cover for a single

Warner's spectacular fielding effort comes to nought, he nearly completed one of those spectacular catches the Australians are pulling off with regularity, Kallis slam the ball towards long-on, Warner leaps to latch onto it, when he lands the backfoot just touches the rope, he lobs the ball up, balances himself and comes back to catch the ball again, he immediately says he's not sure he has taken it cleanly
punches the ball towards long-off for a single
another yorker from Sangwan, Uthappa squeezes it out towards the off side
slaps the ball towards point
clipped off his hips wide of square leg for a double
Pietersen's struggles are over, a yorker from Sangwan crashes into offstump, Pietersen was looking to play that towards the leg side
Kallis bends his knee and drives towards sweeper cover for a single
back of a length and just outside off, an over of singles completed, down to long-off, do you think Bangalore will discuss hitting some boundaries during the time-out coming up?
low full toss outside off, Warner is having a busy time at long-on
Gambhir throws himself to the left at extra cover to stop the ball
on legstump, glanced down to fine leg
full toss on offstump, driven down to long-off
down to long-on for a single
super over from Sangwan, the final ball is pushed back to the bowler
crunched towards point, straight towards the fielder so there wasn't even a single off that slower ball
low full toss on middle and leg, punched to long-on for a single
they just can't break free here these two batsman, slashed towards deep point this time
length ball angling across the batsman, driven to extra cover
short ball on middle, down to fine leg for yet another single
rounds off an over of slower balls, again it is eased to long-on for a single
yet another slower ball, only a single to long-on, Bangalore need to shift to a higher gear here
length ball outside off, driven just wide of extra cover, not great timing, batsmen take a single
third slower ball in a row from Bhatia, Pietersen can only get it as far as extra cover
defended back towards the bowler this time
full ball on middle, pushed towards long-on for a single
Delhi bowlers doing a superb job here, another dot ball as Pietersen can only punch it back to Maharoof
direct hit would have got Delhi the wicket of Kallis, Gambhir misses with one stump to aim at, Kallis had punched the ball towards extra cover before setting off for a tough single
Maharoof appeals for lbw, not sure why, Pietersen is struck on the foot at least two feet outside off, ball runs away towards backward point
just outside off, batsman looks to hoick that to midwicket, no contact
length ball outside off, Pietersen mistimes it towards extra cover

length ball outside off, Pietersen takes two steps out of the crease before the ball is delivered, he is squared up by the delivery, and the ball runs away to point, Pietersen has to scramble back, direct hit would have caught him short, third umpire is called for, KP's safe
pushed down to long-on for a single to end the over
on the pads, whipped towards midwicket this time
length ball, Pietersen strides out and hammers it over long-off
arm ball, Kallis makes room and steers towards backward point
driven towards extra cover, another dot ball
way outside off, Kallis looks to swipe over midwicket but misses
a googly to end the over, it was short and outside off, Pietersen just about gets his bat down in time
crisply driven towards long-off for a single
length ball on the pads, rolls towards midwicket

Warner keeps getting these catches, White's the man to go, batsman looks to go straight but gets it on the outside half of the bat, the ball swirls towards long-off, Warner does the rest, that's Mishra's 12th wicket
on the pads, swung towards short fine
full ball on off, pushed towards cover
back of a length, just outside off, Kallis carves the ball to backward point

high full toss, but not high enough to be a no-ball, White gets it away towards backward point, wants the single but is sent back, he's in the crease in time to beat the direct hit, but they get a run off the ricochet
tapped towards cover this time, gets a quick single
what a shot that is, just timing, a short ball, he stands tall and square-drives past point with absolutely no effort
looks to flay an outside-off ball towards extra cover, gets an inside-edge towards short fine, Sehwag fields smartly
length ball on offstump, blocked down the pitch
outside off, Kallis looks to steer it towards backward point but misses the ball
bowled him, but off the free-hit
that's a no-ball, full toss on the pads, whipped to wide long-on for four, it's a no-ball not for overstepping but for crossing the side line
full ball on the pads, tapped towards mid-on
driven firmly back towards the bowler
googly, fullish and well outside off, defended towards cover
starts with a length ball, pitching on off, driven down to long-off
pushed off the back foot towards cover, the fielder rushes in and fails to pick up, luckily for him there's back up
and again! this time it's a touch slower and Kallis waits a moment before driving wide of the fielder at mid-off
shot! too full and Kallis comes forward and drives through cover with a full flow of the bat, lovely timing and placement
White comes forward, nudges the ball towards point, and calls Kallis through
Maharoof nips the ball back into the right-hander, defended on the front foot
full ball on off stump, driven to cover point where a fumble from Mishra allows the single
